searchText: In general, once we start making fields 0s, can we also make those "zero zero bytes" instead of "x zero bytes" like here (256 zero bytes) to reduce network strain a little? 🙂 I think we also have mixHash and nonce being zeros now, we can remove those too? (to be "zero zero bytes" instead of "X zero bytes") I do recall that there was a motivation to keep those the right byte length but I do not recall this isn't everything wrapped in snappy at this point? I'm happy to make them empty-strings, whatever clients devs say reduces their workload the most works for me
